about_the_game:
In Blind Spot you play as a special agent and your goal is to protect a family from paranormal entities invading their residential house. The agency has set up a camera feed in the house and to allow you to contain the threat in relative safety. 

Observation:

With the cameras you will be able to see the family chill maxing in there domicile (usually sleeping). You must observe  for any ghosts hiding about. To banish a ghost all you have to do is turn on the observed rooms light, but if you do this too often then someone will come for you!

Secure The House:

In addition to cameras, their are some other machines have been made available to you. There's the RC Car that can be used to scare away ghosts and there are mannequins that can be used to trick ghosts. You must also make sure the door to your observation room stays locked.

Exploration:

All the surrounding streets and houses have been evacuated to limit civilian casualties and cover the whole scope of the operation. It is likely that the entity will sabotage the power grid to try and halt operations. If the grid is sabotage then you are permitted to go and fix the problem. Be advised many entities attracted to the house roam the streets, watch your back.

Five Nights With Frendies:

There are five nights that you are required to survive in order to win the game! Each new night will be more difficult than the night before and introduces new challenges and enemies.

Squid Time:

I understand that you may be feeling a little apprehensive about taking on this task. You may even be saying to yourself "holy guacamole I'm probably going to die". But you don't need to worry about death. Advances in technology have allowed us to turn you into a squid if you happen to die. We can turn you back into a human later, but for the moment you'll have to hang tight. As a squid you can still help your team to a limited capacity and since your still on the clock, you'll have to get back to work.

Team Work:

There is a lot of work to be done and it is recommended to play online in a squad. There are many tasks you'll need to accomplish and you'll be able to split the load between your group. You can have for example one of your friends operating the cameras while the other runs around the house securing windows. You can also choose to play with nobody and the game will intelligently even the scales of difficulty to match.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580

short_description: Multiplayer co-op, survival horror game. Play with your friends as you monitor and secure a residential house that is haunted by entities. Use cameras to surveil the property and keep the family inside safe. Watch your back and try to survive!
